review.observation: Full original: black smooth skin, rounded head, continuous tapering tail and short bent limbs. No external pinnae. Perspective separates the far and near foot heights, so the existing single-contact author refusal remains independent of this review.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. External gills, ear openings and all other actual head/neck paint remain present and are not excluded.
